notes.title: Patch 1.0.5 Live
notes.content:
Updated with Patch v1.0.5, which includes:
[list]
[*]Fixed issue in which shield would often leave slightly too early during Dragon special.
[*]Fixed issues with displaying coins earned underneath stages in world map when playing in Hard or Insane mode.
[*]Other minor fixes.
[/list]
Thanks for your support! 
Please report any bugs to support[/*At*/]herringbonegames[/*dOt*/]com
